eligibility_rule: Only approval_status=APPROVED and superseded_by=null are current for new products. Base A-C families are grandfathered APPROVED revision 1 by QUESTION_ID_MAP.json.
runtime_authoring_rule: Question structure and wording are fixed by family template. Runtime may only instantiate declared parameters/number swaps and approved representation rendering. It may not invent or paraphrase a new question.
graph_rule: Cartesian graphs use the approved graph tool / graph rendering contract; do not invent decorative graphs.
